verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say it ships two built-in auth options that Agent provisions for the app, with no separate dashboard signup or OAuth key copying, and that this gives apps per-user identity and data. So the builder does scaffold sign-up and login. The evidence never names the specific methods, so email login and social providers are only implied by the mention of OAuth keys. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of email/password and named social providers, and independent hands-on confirmation of Agent-scaffolded auth in built apps.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Replit ships two built-in auth options. Both are provisioned by Agent — no separate dashboard signup, no copy-pasting of OAuth keys.
Built-in services with zero setup- Authentication, Database, Hosting, and Monitoring
Auth — short for authentication — is what gives your app the concept of a "user".
Save data per user — bookings, settings, content, history.
